candidate_grammar: A zero-dependency Node receiver independently parses and validates the exact ten archived query, continuation and terminal-resolution receipt byte triples. A comparison gate returns ImplementationAgreement only when the Python and Node classifications and canonical preserved tuples agree and their source fingerprints differ. Any absent result, same-source provenance, classification divergence or preserved-tuple divergence returns UnknownImplementationAgreement.
enforcement: Run exactly ten Node receiver processes with a one-second timeout and 32 MiB V8 old-space cap; the campaign has a twenty-second alarm. Pin the parent execution and both receiver sources. Count Node structural work and comparison work separately. Inputs remain read-only and new evidence uses write-new temporary files, fsync, same-directory atomic replacement and directory fsync.

Four comparison-layer controls must return UnknownImplementationAgreement. Inputs remain byte-identical; every authority flag and fuel delta stays false or zero.
exit: Stop on the first pin, process, output, input-mutation, authority, accounting or resource failure. No correction replay is authorized. A genuine implementation divergence is retained as UnknownImplementationAgreement and is not repaired by spending more fuel.
